issues.on_page: Transfers in (out): General (10,000), Street 85,000, Total Governmental Funds 75,000
issues.issue: Net governmental transfer recorded as transfers_in with transfers_out null; gross is 85,000 in (Street) and 10,000 out (General). Net is what the Total Governmental Funds column prints and it reconciles, but the gross amounts are not shown.
Beginning cash taken from the printed fund balance line (modified cash basis, no liabilities), not from a cash line. Equal under modified cash basis, but it is an assumption.

issues.on_page: Contributions 10,000 (p5); shown as Capital Grants and Contributions (p3) and as 'Grants' on the budget schedule (p9)
issues.issue: Could be a government capital grant (intergovernmental/state aid or federal grants) rather than a private donation. The page doesn't say who gave it.

issues.on_page: Intergovernmental 75,806 (Street Fund only, p5; 'State allocation' on p3)
issues.issue: All of it is in the Street Fund and is labelled State allocation, so it is likely highway allocation. 'other state aid' is defensible but less specific.
